ApexAi builds guarded web-data and business communications products with operator, API, and agent interfaces. **Scrapy** turns web sources into owned artifacts and versioned datasets. **Communications** runs business conversations on your own Twilio, SendGrid, and Telegram accounts, with consent and history built in.

Each product owns its rules. A person working in Telegram, an application calling ApexAPI, and an AI agent using ApexMCP all pass the same product policy before anything runs, and all get evidence back.

<a href="https://apexaiofficial.com/scrapy"><picture><source media="(max-width: 640px)" srcset="assets/scrapy-narrow.svg"><img src="assets/scrapy.svg" width="100%" alt="Scrapy, web-data operations: turn web sources into owned artifacts and versioned datasets. Workflow from source to dataset: choose a cataloged source, pass the policy and egress gate, crawl, fetch, or render, classify and store artifacts, publish a dataset version, then search and fetch records."></picture></a>

<a href="https://apexaiofficial.com/communications"><picture><source media="(max-width: 640px)" srcset="assets/communications-narrow.svg"><img src="assets/communications.svg" width="100%" alt="Communications, business communications: on your own provider accounts, with consent and history built in. Workflow from intent to evidence: communication intent, workspace and role, consent and suppression, the Trust and Safety gate, the workspace provider, then delivery and history."></picture></a>
